noun_definition: Chat refers to the section of the app where users can send and receive messages, and it is expected to maintain cursor focus when navigating between the chat and room sections.
Room refers to a section of the app where users can interact or communicate, and it is noted that the cursor focus remains present when navigating to this section.
Cursor refers to the position indicator in the chat section where the user can input text, which is expected to remain focused when switching between the chat and room sections of the app.
Focus refers to the active position of the cursor within the chat section of the app, which should remain consistent when switching between the chat and room sections.
Chat section refers to the area in the application where users can send and receive messages, and it is expected to maintain cursor focus when switching between the chat and room views.
